testcase.name: Scenario: Switch between unpinned panel expansions: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:142:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch between unpinned panel expansions ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the 3D Model Modify panel's unpinned additional command area is open ✔ When the user clicks the Simplification panel expansion arrow ✔ Then the Modify additional command area closes ✔ And the Simplification additional command area opens ✔ And it displays "Remove Details", "Fill Voids", and "Define Envelopes" ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the viewport ✔ Then the Simplification additional command area closes ✔ And the part and 3D Model ribbon remain visible
